scopedClaim: In the supplied detuned pair X06/X22, equal sorted eigenvalues coexist with different fixed-port intensity responses and opposite oriented loop descriptors. The supplied Hamiltonians are complex conjugates with the same distinct ordered onsite values [0,0.2,-0.35]. This supports testing orientation-sensitive, contact-resolved descriptors; it does not establish a new material mechanism. Fixed physical ports must remain fixed when assessing response equivalence.

proposedDescriptorOrTest.name: Fixed-port response and explicit gauge/permutation controls
proposedDescriptorOrTest.descriptor: Retain the full energy-indexed labeled-port intensity matrix and the ordered complex loop product alongside the eigenvalues. Add the declaration of physical contact labels and whether a comparison permits passive relabeling.
proposedDescriptorOrTest.question: Can the observed distinction be removed by local rephasing while physical ports stay fixed, and how does explicitly allowed passive port permutation differ between detuned and symmetric controls?
procedure: Use only the provided X06/X22 Hamiltonians to reproduce the three supplied responses with the original simulator contact model; record the fixed physical port-to-site map. Require numerical reproduction before drawing conclusions.

Apply diagonal unitary rephasings H -> D H D† and transform contact basis conventions consistently. Recompute the ordered loop and the intensity matrices at the original and four supplied held-out sample indices. Gauge covariance predicts unchanged fixed-port intensities and unchanged ordered loop; the held-out energies must be identified from authorized simulator metadata before energy-specific claims.

Enumerate all six simultaneous site permutations, carrying onsite values, edges, and physical contact metadata together. Report both fixed physical labels and a separately declared passive relabeling comparison T -> P T Pᵀ. Do not accept an independently optimized input/output permutation as physical equivalence.

For the detuned pair, require any proposed symmetry that preserves the physical onsite assignment to preserve [0,0.2,-0.35]. Its three distinct entries allow only the identity permutation under that restriction. Test whether any gauge-only map can match the matrices and ordered loop; opposite nonreal loop products predict it cannot.

Create an explicitly labeled symmetric control by replacing both onsite vectors with [0,0,0] while retaining their supplied conjugate hoppings. With symmetry-compatible equal contacts, test an odd site permutation plus any required rephasing as a permitted passive relabeling. Compare the fixed-port response separately: a passive relabeling match does not establish equality at fixed physical ports. If the simulator contacts break that symmetry, retain their asymmetry and flag that the symmetric-contact control is not instantiated.
controls: Identity rephasing and identity permutation reproduce the original arrays.
Seeded nontrivial local rephasings leave the ordered loop unchanged.
An odd orientation permutation conjugates the loop when the directed edge convention is carried explicitly.
Keep numerical precision, normalization, energy ordering, and contact implementation fixed.

whatChangedFromOwnFirstPass: My isolated transport packet could identify sampled intensity classes and transpose relations but supplied no Hamiltonians, onsite pattern, loop values, or spectra. The coalition now authorizes those facts for X06/X22 and published summaries only. This narrows the broad denser-grid proposal to a specific gauge/permutation test with fixed physical contacts, separating detuning-pinned site identities from a deliberately constructed symmetric control.
alternativeExplanation: A different port-label convention, inconsistent contact transformation, or numerical implementation error could create an apparent disagreement. Equal eigenvalues constrain a different summary of the same toy system; representation-specific equivalence alone does not demonstrate physical novelty. Permutation equivalence of an explicitly symmetric control would not transfer to the detuned pair or erase their fixed-port distinction.

failureCriterion.reproductionGate: If any original response entry differs from the supplied value by more than 1e-12, suspend interpretation and investigate the implementation.
failureCriterion.gaugeControl: A consistently transformed gauge copy that changes an ordered loop by more than 1e-12 or any fixed-port intensity by more than 1e-10 falsifies the claimed gauge/contact implementation consistency.
failureCriterion.detunedHypothesis: An explicit diagonal unitary map matching X06 to X22 to Hamiltonian max-entry residual <=1e-10 while retaining onsite assignments and reproducing their opposite nonreal ordered loops would falsify the proposed gauge-only obstruction and require checking the loop convention.
failureCriterion.symmetricControl: Under verified symmetry-compatible equal contacts, failure of the proposed odd-permutation Hamiltonian match or simultaneous port-covariant intensity match at residual <=1e-10 falsifies that control prediction. A permutation-only match must be reported separately from equality with physical ports fixed.
failureCriterion.limits: All thresholds are numerical conventions, not experimental uncertainty estimates; finite sampled agreement is not an all-energy proof.

validationScope: Proposed numerical experiment within this three-site coherent-scattering toy, using the two authorized Hamiltonians and explicitly constructed controls. No new calculations of the proposed experiment are reported. The supplied held-out matrices have no energy labels in this packet, so only their sample ordering is presently available. No experimental, fabrication, global novelty, material superiority, or agent superiority claim; procedural isolation is not statistical independence.
